name: OpenVibe.Bot

liveness.means: the process answers HTTP and reports online devices and outbox status; database, Valkey and Network readiness are checked by /api/ready

drains: job timers cleared and the Network key refresh stopped
device and operator WebSockets closed (1001) and the outbox relay stopped
HTTP server closed: requests in flight get Connection: close and up to 4 s to finish, idle connections close at once, whatever is open after 4 s is cut
PostgreSQL pool and Valkey client closed, then exit 0
shutdown.note: openvibe-sdk/service gracefulStop (drainMs 4000, deadlineMs 5000, deadlineExitCode 0) runs these steps on SIGTERM or SIGINT and exits 0 after 5 s whatever is still open; the unit sends SIGTERM and allows 10 s (TimeoutStopSec)

resumes.what: the one-second turn-queue sweep expires overdue turns and promotes waiting operators; pairing-code and audit-prune timers restart
device and operator WebSockets reconnect; commands are never queued or replayed after a disconnect
unsent bot.* events in bot_event_outbox are published when the relay restarts (at least once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy restores the previous sha when /api/ready does not return 2xx within the configured readiness timeout
rollback.window: automatic while ovhost waits for readiness after restart; manual afterwards while the earlier release remains compatible with the database

blockers.none: the current migration creates Bot's initial PostgreSQL schema and does not drop or rename existing data

leases.none: no expiring work claims: PostgreSQL row locks serialize queue changes and an advisory lock serializes boot migrations; WebSocket sessions are in memory

notes: Robot and device control service on openvibe-ovh since 2026-10-02; the public site uses HTTPS while health and readiness are loopback-only. Non-HTTP bindings: the device WebSocket /device carries bot.device-message@1 frames (and platform.job-frame@1 jobs); the operator WebSocket /control carries bot.command@1, answered by bot.command-result@1.
